tldr: Jupiter through the 1st house expands your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 1st house, it makes more room around your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
